title: Each summary figure's information icon reveals its plain explanation
refs: SV-8661 (WIP Story 5; WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S5a-R2 — Estimates explanation locked verbatim per Fabian design review; Chris Ward 2026-08-18 confirmed keep longer wording and drop the short S5-R12 Estimates leftover)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open with the summary strip visible.
custom_steps:
1. Hover (or focus, or tap) the small information icon next to each of the seven summary figures, one at a time.
2. Read each revealed explanation and compare it word-for-word to the expected text.
custom_expected:
1. Total Earned — "Work you have already done but have not billed yet — the money waiting to be collected."
2. Total Remaining — "Approved work you still have to do — the money that comes in once it is finished."
3. Not Started — "Approved jobs nobody has started yet. The full amount is still ahead."
4. Started — Earned — "Jobs in progress: the work already done but not billed yet."
5. Started — Remaining — "Jobs in progress: the work still left to finish."
6. Ready to Invoice — "Finished jobs, ready to bill the customer."
7. Estimates — "The total value of all estimate lines that have not yet been approved, including lines awaiting authorization on open work orders."
8. Each explanation appears on hover, on keyboard focus, and on tap.

---
